name: plass
description: A true WYSIWYG editor with publication-quality typesetting (oracle layout architecture)
author: Taylor J. Weidman

scripts.build: npm run verify:sidecar && npm run check:unused && npm run check:exports && npm run check:cycles && tsc --noEmit && vite build
scripts.generate:notices: node --import tsx scripts/generate-third-party-notices.ts && node --import tsx scripts/generate-sidecar-notices.ts && node --import tsx scripts/generate-typst-wasm-notices.ts
scripts.verify:licenses: node --import tsx scripts/generate-third-party-notices.ts --check && node --import tsx scripts/generate-sidecar-notices.ts --check && node --import tsx scripts/generate-typst-wasm-notices.ts --check
scripts.test: tsx src/transaction-impact.test.ts && tsx src/layout/knuth-plass.test.ts && tsx src/layout/block-layout.test.ts && tsx src/layout/line-decorations.test.ts && tsx src/layout/forced-layout.test.ts && tsx src/layout/flow-rules.test.ts && tsx src/layout/pagination-snapshot.test.ts && tsx src/layout/pagination-suffix.test.ts && tsx src/layout/pagination-suffix-control.test.ts && tsx src/layout/layout-scheduler.test.ts && tsx src/layout/oracle-coordinator.test.ts && tsx src/layout/page-parity.test.ts && tsx src/layout/typst-oracle.test.ts && tsx src/layout/page-oracle.test.ts && tsx src/layout/table-rows.test.ts && tsx src/table-integrity.test.ts && tsx src/native-table.test.ts && tsx src/typ-parser.test.ts && tsx src/md-round.test.ts && tsx src/collapse-spaces.test.ts && tsx src/security.test.ts && tsx src/font-registry.test.ts
scripts.test:layout: tsx src/layout/port/port-smoke.test.ts && tsx src/layout/port/shape-cache.test.ts && tsx src/layout/port/incremental-linebreak.test.ts && tsx src/layout/font-certification.test.ts
